quest.title: Steaming Hot Swim
quest.description: Pele Nui of the People of the Springs seems to have encountered some trouble...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Maybe I can coax him out.

dialogues.speaker: Pele Nui
dialogues.text: Well... Yeah, sure, why not? Maybe a change of pace is just what the doctor ordered, eh? Good luck, then.

dialogues.speaker: Pele Nui
dialogues.text: Honestly, what's gotten into it? Before, I could just pat his <color=#00E1FFFF>head</color> or <color=#00E1FFFF>tummy</color>, and he'd just do what he was told...

talks.objective: Try communicating with the lazy little Koholasaurus

dialogues.speaker: Lazy Koholasaurus
dialogues.text: Hroo...? Rrroo, rroo...

response.speaker: Lazy Koholasaurus
response.text: (The little Koholasaurus seems rather happy. He is sitting by the shore — you should be able to grab him and bring him up now...)

response.speaker: Black Screen
response.text: The little Koholasaurus finally quiets down. You carefully carry him up onto the shore...

response.speaker: Lazy Koholasaurus
response.text: (The little Koholasaurus seems rather happy. He is sitting by the shore — you should be able to grab him and bring him up now...)

response.speaker: Lazy Koholasaurus
response.text: (The little Koholasaurus seems quite unhappy, and he splashes water all over your face.)

response.speaker: Lazy Koholasaurus
response.text: (The little Koholasaurus watches you expectantly. Time to find a different way to cajole him...)

dialogues.speaker: Pele Nui
dialogues.text: Well, you sure enjoyed yourself, huh? As for me, I need to go get changed...

dialogues.speaker: Lazy Koholasaurus
dialogues.text: Hroo! Rooh—

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: You're all wet...

dialogues.speaker: Pele Nui
dialogues.text: *cough* He finally decided to listen — just needed to play with him for a bit, you know?

dialogues.speaker: Pele Nui
dialogues.text: You're done cleaning the spring over there? Thanks a lot, then. Here, take this as your reward.

dialogues.speaker: Pele Nui
dialogues.text: Once I'm done cleaning the others, I'll need a change of clothes... Wait, where'd that kid run off to?

dialogues.speaker: Lazy Koholasaurus
dialogues.text: Wrooh! Hroo—

dialogues.speaker: Pele Nui
dialogues.text: Hey, get back here! The springs over there haven't been cleaned yet!

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: The little Koholasaurus jumps joyously toward the other hot spring, with the shouting Pele Nui in hot pursuit...

dialogues.speaker: Pele Nui
dialogues.text: Hmm? Why did he climb ashore by himself? Did he tire of playing?

dialogues.speaker: Pele Nui
dialogues.text: ...Well, whatever the case, thanks so much for your help. Here, take your payment. I'll go get him something nice to eat now...

dialogues.speaker: Pele Nui
dialogues.text: Huh? Where's he gone? H—He hasn't dived back into the hot springs again, has he?

dialogues.speaker: Lazy Koholasaurus
dialogues.text: Hroo! Rroooh—

dialogues.speaker: Pele Nui
dialogues.text: Hey, get back here! The springs over there haven't been cleaned yet!

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: The little Koholasaurus jumps joyously toward the other hot spring, with the shouting Pele Nui in hot pursuit...

dialogues.speaker: Pele Nui
dialogues.text: Hahaha. Looks like the kid's fond of you. You convinced him to come along right away.

dialogues.speaker: Pele Nui
dialogues.text: Thanks so much. Here's your payment. I'll go get him something nice to eat now...

dialogues.speaker: Pele Nui
dialogues.text: Huh? Where's he gone? H—He hasn't dived back into the hot springs again, has he?

dialogues.speaker: Lazy Koholasaurus
dialogues.text: Rooo! Wroo—

dialogues.speaker: Pele Nui
dialogues.text: Hey, get back here! The springs over there haven't been cleaned yet!

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: The little Koholasaurus jumps joyously toward the other hot spring, with the shouting Pele Nui in hot pursuit...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I can help you clean the other springs.

dialogues.speaker: Pele Nui
dialogues.text: Would you really? That'd be great, because I'm pretty overwhelmed here.

dialogues.speaker: Pele Nui
dialogues.text: In that case, uh, just start from that one over there.

dialogues.speaker: Pele Nui
dialogues.text: I already scrubbed the bottom a few days back, so all you need to do is clear the junk floating on the surface.

dialogues.speaker: Pele Nui
dialogues.text: I'm counting on you, then. I'll continue persuading this little fella.

dialogues.speaker: Pele Nui
dialogues.text: *sigh* Honestly, what's gotten into him? Before, I could just pat his head or tummy, and he'd just do what he was told...

talks.objective: Pick up the junk in the hot spring

dialogues.speaker: Pele Nui
dialogues.text: *sigh* Why's he throwing a tantrum like this...

dialogues.speaker: Pele Nui
dialogues.text: Could you please come ashore, just for a bit? I need to clean up the springs over here.

dialogues.speaker: Lazy Koholasaurus
dialogues.text: Roar...

dialogues.speaker: Pele Nui
dialogues.text: Come on now, be a good boy! If not, I'm going to have to pick you up myself!

dialogues.speaker: Lazy Koholasaurus
dialogues.text: Roar!

dialogues.speaker: Pele Nui
dialogues.text: And he's gone in a flash, just like that. Ugh, how am I going to get a hold of him now...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: What are you up to?

dialogues.speaker: Pele Nui
dialogues.text: Hmm? You here for a hot spring bath? Sorry, but I'm in the middle of cleaning this pool here, so you might have to wait a moment.

dialogues.speaker: Pele Nui
dialogues.text: Also, this lunk won't come up and out no matter what I say. *sigh* And I've got so many more pools to clean, too.

dialogues.speaker: Pele Nui
dialogues.text: Could he be throwing a tantrum because I carried him out a few days earlier? Seriously, what a pain...

dialogues.speaker: Lazy Koholasaurus
dialogues.text: Phew... New friend... Hoo...

response.speaker: Lazy Koholasaurus
response.text: (The little Koholasaurus seems rather happy. He is sitting by the shore...)

response.speaker: Black Screen
response.text: The little Koholasaurus yawns and climbs ashore slowly...

response.speaker: Lazy Koholasaurus
response.text: (The little Koholasaurus seems rather happy. He is sitting by the shore...)

response.speaker: Lazy Koholasaurus
response.text: (The little Koholasaurus seems quite unhappy, and he splashes water all over your face.)

response.speaker: Lazy Koholasaurus
response.text: (The little Koholasaurus watches you expectantly. Time to find a different way to cajole him...)

dialogues.speaker: Pele Nui
dialogues.text: I'll leave the hot spring over there to you. I'll continue trying to persuade this little fella...

dialogues.speaker: Lazy Koholasaurus
dialogues.text: Hroo...? Rrroo, rroo...

dialogues.speaker: Lazy Koholasaurus
dialogues.text: Phew... New friend... Hoo...
